prompt: A functional RPG launcher. Fire flying rockets where I aim, with recoil, a smoke trail, a visible explosion on collision, and actual destruction of walls and the gate. Let me reload and fire again.

invention.name: Bad Company RPG
invention.description: A shoulder-fired RPG with flying rockets, physical recoil, drifting smoke, and fiery impact blasts that demolish nearby wall panels and the gate. Manually reload for another shot.
invention.usage: Aim with the camera and press F or click to fire. Press again to reload; wait for “Loaded,” then fire again. Stand back from your target!
limitations: One rocket per load; reloading takes 1.2 seconds.
Close explosions knock you back and can throw you off ledges.
Blasts destroy intersecting structural panels as whole pieces, not individual brick-sized holes. Ground, banks, and the rooftop foundation ‘
